linear_api_key.title: Linear API key (optional)
linear_api_key.description: Only needed for /rpi:stages, which creates, renames or archives Linear workflow states. Generate one at Settings > Security & access > Personal API keys. Every other command reaches Linear over OAuth through the bundled MCP server and needs no key. Leave blank if you are not provisioning workflow states.
